scope: Finite word inventory only; no heap searches, theorem proofs, or new solve claims. 124 retained bounded-AC/Aut components are an upper bound, not proved distinct AC classes.

definitions.exponents: Lowercase counts +1; uppercase counts -1. Matrices keep file relator order and x,y columns.
definitions.signed_permutation_exponent_class: Lexicographic minimum under swapping/negating rows and swapping/negating columns only, not full Nielsen equivalence.
definitions.cyclic_blocks: Maximal same-generator runs, with signed integer exponent; merge first/last if they have the same generator. Canonical pattern minimizes cyclic rotations and inverse-word patterns, keeping generator labels.
definitions.stable_sequence: For each occurrence of nominated stable generator t around the cyclic word, record (its sign, exponent of the other generator until next t). Adjacent t letters give a zero exponent. Canonical sequence minimizes cyclic rotation and inverse-word sequences. This is descriptive and does not assume an HNN theorem.
definitions.two_opposite_stable: Exactly two occurrences of chosen stable generator, one positive and one negative. The between-occurrence base powers are literal syntax, not a completion theorem.

panel.selection: A priori for future tests: cover every observed total length 13 through 25, then add same-versus-opposite stable signs, larger/equal powers, maximal signed exponents, and balanced long relators. Selection uses raw structural features and initial-to-best provenance only, never a future recognizer outcome. This is a development diagnostic panel, not a representative statistical sample or validation set.
